about: Mechanized Diataxis documentation model for Verdant Engine: maps every stakeholder in app/src/Architecture.lex.tex to a guide persona, defines engine glossary terms, and configures plain-language and accessibility checks.

personas.name: Kai
personas.need: A runnable 3D game world with ECS, rigid-body physics, spatial audio, and a starter template.

asks.discover: What can Verdant Engine build in the browser and in Rust?
asks.evaluate: Does verdant-core give me real 3D physics, culling, and asset export?
asks.learn: Walk me from an empty Cargo crate to a running 3D scene.
asks.build: How do I spawn entities, step physics, and export a scene?
asks.scale: How do I keep simulation deterministic across frames?

personas.name: Iris
personas.need: Procedural terrain, botanical flora, validated WGSL shaders, and binary glTF 2.0 exports.

asks.discover: Which 3D geometry, material, and shader standards does the engine speak?
asks.evaluate: Do exported scenes open cleanly in standard 3D tools?
asks.learn: Show me how terrain heightfields and L-system flora are generated.
asks.build: How do I author PBR materials, validate WGSL shaders, and export GLB files?
asks.scale: How are morph targets and mesh normals kept valid at scale?

personas.name: Otto
personas.need: Exact API types, 60fps worker job budgets, binary world snapshots, and zero magic constants.

asks.discover: How is the runtime split across crates, workers, and frame stages?
asks.evaluate: Are frame budgets, snapshots, and numeric kernels bounded?
asks.learn: Where does each subsystem live in crates/verdant-core?
asks.build: Which types schedule jobs and serialize world state?
asks.scale: What are the exact API signatures, error variants, and frame limits?

personas.name: Vera
personas.need: Proof that world expansion is monotonic, structures are in static equilibrium, and inputs are validated.

asks.discover: What invariants govern world synthesis and asset safety?
asks.evaluate: Why do monuments and the autonomous rover appear only at present observation, and how are shaders and snapshots checked?
asks.learn: How are Heyman middle-third statics and safety factors verified?
asks.build: What refuses a tampered snapshot or an invalid WGSL shader?
asks.scale: How does the browser worker isolate and verify the engine archive?

personas.name: Wren
personas.need: A responsive, clutter-free 60fps 3D viewport with orbit and walk cameras plus spatial audio.

asks.discover: How does Verdant Engine power the living 3D sanctuary of Verdant Resonance in the browser?
asks.evaluate: Does the 3D viewport stay responsive on both phones and desktop monitors?
asks.learn: How do camera modes, expansion scrubbing, and spatial chimes work?
asks.build: Which seven structures and kinetic actors inhabit the sanctuary?
asks.scale: How does the studio stay fast within a small browser download budget?

reading.tutorial: A tutorial: follow the steps in order. Each step builds on the one before it.
reading.howToGuide: A how-to guide: each section completes one practical engine task.
reading.reference: Reference: look up types, budgets, and commands in any order.
reading.explanation: Explanation: read end to end to understand the design and physics.
reading.home: Start here. Choose your role or jump straight to a tutorial, guide, or API reference.

terms.plain: The entity-component-system container in verdant-core that stores entities, parent-child transforms, meshes, and PBR materials.
A tree of 3D bounding boxes partitioned by surface area so raycasts and camera frustum checks skip distant geometry.
WebGPU Shading Language: the W3C standard shader language validated in Verdant Engine by naga.
The Khronos Group 3D scene transmission standard. GLB is its single-file binary container.
Jacques Heyman's masonry stability rule: thrust eccentricity stays within one sixth of wall thickness so joints remain in compression.
A deterministic binary save of tick count, expansion scale, and entity transforms protected by a 32-byte SHA-256 digest.
